dashboard_recap.headline: MLB Daily Recap - June 08, 2026
dashboard_recap.article:
**Mariners' Comeback Secures 6-3 Win Over Orioles, Rays Shut Down Red Sox**

The Seattle Mariners capitalized on a strong team effort to take down the Baltimore Orioles 6-3 on Wednesday. Josh Naylor led the charge with a 2-hit, 4-RBI performance, including a crucial home run. Andrés Muñoz earned his first save of the season after a dominant 1-inning outing with 2 strikeouts. Emerson Hancock earned the win with 6 innings pitched, allowing 3 earned runs.

Meanwhile, the Tampa Bay Rays cooled off the Boston Red Sox with a 3-1 victory. Yandy Díaz was the top performer, hitting a home run and driving in 2 runs. Connelly Early took the loss despite a strong outing, allowing just 1 earned run in 4 innings. Ian Seymour was impressive in relief for the Rays, striking out 5 batters.

The New York Yankees outlasted the Cleveland Guardians 7-5 behind a 2-hit, 3-RBI performance from Paul Goldschmidt. David Bednar earned the win and saved the game with 2 scoreless innings.
